variant_reviews.comparison: Use a Dirac initial law at x and the stationary transition kernel applied to the latest history coordinate to instantiate trajMeasure. This represents a chain started at each x without choosing a conditional expectation on a potentially null event X0=x. With measurable bounded reward and a discount strictly below one, a geometric domination argument can justify the real infinite sum and its expectation; those proofs are not supplied by trajMeasure or the total Bochner integral, which returns zero outside integrability. The one-step Bellman identity and uniqueness on a specified bounded-function space require separate arguments. This true value is not the projected RKHS target except in the explicitly realizable source families.
